review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Role As a Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for delivering resilient, secure and scalable infrastructure solutions across data centre, network, cloud and security domains. Key responsibilities include: Designing and implementing enterprise infrastructure solutions across data centre and Azure environments. Understanding of regulatory, audit and risk requirements within controlled environments.
eligibility_evidence: A leading global investment management organisation is undertaking a significant technology transformation, modernising its infrastructure estate from traditional data centres to a secure, scalable and cloud-first hybrid environment.

Working alongside Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Architecture teams, you will lead technical initiatives including cloud adoption, infrastructure transformation, hybrid connectivity, modernisation projects and automation.
Leading migration and transformation initiatives from on-premise infrastructure to hybrid cloud architectures.
Building and managing secure hybrid connectivity between data centres and Microsoft Azure.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering position focused on designing, delivering and modernising enterprise infrastructure across both on-premises and Azure cloud platforms. Providing senior technical expertise during complex incidents and infrastructure challenges. What We're Looking For Data Centre & Infrastructure Expertise Strong experience managing and engineering enterprise data centre environments. Expertise across LAN/WAN networks, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VPN technologies and network security. Azure & Cloud Engineering Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying and supporting Microsoft Azure environments. Understanding of regulatory, audit and risk requirements within controlled environments.
